what_breaks: 403 and 404 both look like 'not allowed'
symptom: you go looking for an API key to fix a bucket name that does not exist; S3 answers NoSuchBucket (404) for a wrong name and AccessDenied (403) for a real one, and assert resp.ok collapses the difference
fix: read the error body before authenticating: 404 needs a new name, 403 needs a key

what_breaks: a public-looking bucket is not free to fetch
symptom: landsat-pds reads as open, then answers 403 'Anonymous users cannot invoke requests against Requester Pays buckets. Please authenticate.' -- the owner pays egress, so the bytes are billable to whoever pulls them
fix: requests pays nothing; Athena or Spectrum over an open bucket does

what_breaks: free public data still refuses an anonymous request
symptom: POST to the public-data project returns 401 'Request is missing required authentication credential' before the query is even looked at
fix: a Google account and project; the sandbox needs no credit card, and the first 1 TiB of query processing per month is free

what_breaks: CSV has a names row AND a units row
symptom: first row of strings; off-by-one on every row after
fix: pd.read_csv(..., skiprows=[1])

what_breaks: index expression is part of the parameter NAME, not its value
symptom: 500 destinationVariableName=... wasn't found -- from either mistake
fix: hand-build the query string; params= cannot express it

what_breaks: curl reads [ ] as a glob pattern
symptom: exit code 3, URL malformat, and NO message under -s
fix: curl -g / --globoff

what_breaks: .time=first / .lat=first are a no-op
symptom: byte-identical response; you get 520x the data you asked for
fix: shrink the lat/lon box instead

what_breaks: constraint variables (&time=) rejected in griddap
symptom: 400: '&' must be followed by a .griddap server variable
fix: use the index form only

what_breaks: strides in the index [(0):(1):(29)] rejected
symptom: 400: For variable=... axis#0=time Constraint=...
fix: no strides exist; shrink the box

what_breaks: grid coordinates are float32
symptom: latitude.max() = 36.81999969 is 'outside' the box you asked for
fix: compare with a 1e-3 tolerance, never exactly

what_breaks: NaN fill is skipped by reductions; -999.0 fill is not
symptom: mean silently wrong, no error
fix: check the min, and mask explicitly

what_breaks: large CSV responses are paged
symptom: page 2 without page 1 returns empty with HTTP 200
fix: request pages in order

what_breaks: AAAA records but no IPv6 route
symptom: requests ~100x slower than curl; every call takes exactly the timeout
fix: force AF_INET (the workshop helper does this)

what_breaks: the data/ level is mandatory when FETCHING
symptom: 404 with NoSuchKey -- reads as a permissions problem
fix: include /data/ in the object key

what_breaks: error bodies are XML even from the JSON API
symptom: r.json() raises JSONDecodeError, hiding the real message
fix: raise_for_status() then read r.text

what_breaks: three capitalisations in one path
symptom: directory all-lower, file title-case, trailing unit lower: TOL_1h not TOL_1H
fix: copy a real listing, do not construct names by upper()

what_breaks: aws s3 honours ~/.aws/config
symptom: commands silently redirected to a local MinIO on localhost:9000
fix: use the GCS JSON API -- no profile, no region, no credentials

what_breaks: same recording at four resolutions
symptom: psd_1h is ~456 MB against tol_1h at ~0.7 MB
fix: list first, read the size, then download

what_breaks: N_PARAM is in ds.sizes but unused by TEMP/PSAL/PRES
symptom: ValueError on isel, or a silently wrong selection if you ignore it
fix: check .shape before indexing

what_breaks: QC flags are bytes in _prof.nc, int8 in per-cycle files
symptom: (qc == 1) is silently all-False
fix: decode to int first; count the codes, do not use .all()

what_breaks: no index and no search API over 4,261 floats
symptom: /index/, /dac/index/, _prof_index.txt all 404
fix: plan for screening, or use a source that has an index

what_breaks: no small file holds a float's position
symptom: _meta.nc (35 KB) and _tech.nc (2.8 MB) both lack LATITUDE
fix: position is in _prof.nc; screening costs 689 KB per candidate

what_breaks: argopy is broken against erddapy 3.x
symptom: imports the removed _quote_string_constraints
fix: fetch GDAC netCDF directly; do not downgrade xarray

what_breaks: line 0 is names, line 1 is units, data starts at line 2
symptom: columns named #yr, mo, dy; KeyError much later
fix: parse lines[0], slice from lines[2]

what_breaks: resolution is not uniform within a year file
symptom: 7,835 rows for 2019, not 8,760; file starts 5 January
fix: resample explicitly; never assume hourly

what_breaks: sentinels are per column, and 99 is a valid bearing
symptom: a blanket >= 99 filter deletes real easterly winds
fix: mask per column: 99 generally, 999 for WDIR/MWD

what_breaks: RangeIndex Series into DataFrame(index=DatetimeIndex)
symptom: aligns on index; every column silently NaN
fix: pass .to_numpy() so values are positional

what_breaks: wind direction is FROM, and bearings wrap
symptom: mean(350, 10) = 180, the exact opposite of 0; 79.6 deg error over 2019
fix: average the u/v vectors, then atan2

what_breaks: Conservative Temperature is degrees C, not Kelvin
symptom: returns nan with only a RuntimeWarning; propagates silently
fix: pass degC, or convert with gsw.CT_from_t

what_breaks: SA is not SP
symptom: SA_from_SP needs pressure AND position; ~0.17 g/kg apart
fix: use gsw.SA_from_SP(sp, p, lon, lat)

what_breaks: dc/dp is ~17 m/s per 1000 dbar
symptom: a per-dbar reading of a per-1000 quantity is 100x wrong
fix: state the units of whatever you are comparing against

what_breaks: describe with no filter returns a 170 MB catalogue
symptom: multi-minute hang on a 'describe' call
fix: always pass --dataset-id and a filter

what_breaks: the flag is --end-datetime
symptom: not --stop-datetime, which is rejected
fix: check --help; the CLI is not consistent across tools

what_breaks: advertised variable count is reported as 0
symptom: a correct dataset that looks empty
fix: do not trust the summary; request variables explicitly

what_breaks: the human Product ID and the CLI dataset id differ
symptom: 'Dataset not found' for GLOBAL_MULTIYEAR_PHY_001_030, which is live
fix: the CLI wants the CMEMS product code cmems_mod_glo_phy_my_0.083deg_P1D-m

what_breaks: the error tells you to check the dataset id
symptom: the id looks authoritative, so you start editing a correct one
fix: diff the failing argv against a working one before theorising

what_breaks: login env vars are COPERNICUSMARINE_SERVICE_USERNAME/PASSWORD
symptom: COPERNICUS_USERNAME / COPERNICUS_PASSWORD are silently ignored
fix: read `copernicusmarine login --help` for the real names

what_breaks: Postgres names every avg() result 'avg'
symptom: three averages in one SELECT produce duplicate column names
fix: alias every aggregate explicitly

what_breaks: int(31.5) uses banker's rounding
symptom: 31.5 Hz becomes band_32hz, 62.5 would become band_62hz
fix: state the rule, and test the boundary case
